heading.en: Why has our population grown so fast?
heading.kn: ನಮ್ಮ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಇಷ್ಟು ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಏಕೆ ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು?

hook.en: India had about 350 million people at independence; by 2011 it had crossed 1.2 billion. Better health care lowered death rates far faster than birth rates fell.
hook.kn: ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯದ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು 35 ಕೋಟಿ ಇದ್ದ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ 2011ರಲ್ಲಿ 120 ಕೋಟಿ ದಾಟಿತು. ಮರಣ ದರ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಯಿತು.

body.en: Rapid fall in the death rate, maternal mortality and infant mortality, together with more people of reproductive age, caused the *population* explosion. To control it, couples are motivated to have small families using contraceptives, and the legal marriageable age is 18 years for females and 21 years for males. An ideal contraceptive is user-friendly, easily available, effective, reversible and has few or no side effects.
body.kn: ಮರಣ ದರ, ತಾಯಿ ಮರಣ ದರ ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಶು ಮರಣ ದರಗಳ ಇಳಿಕೆ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯಾ ಸ್ಫೋಟಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣ. ವಿವಾಹದ ಕಾನೂನು ವಯಸ್ಸು ಸ್ತ್ರೀಯರಿಗೆ 18, ಪುರುಷರಿಗೆ 21. ಆದರ್ಶ ಗರ್ಭನಿರೋಧಕ ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ, ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸಬಹುದಾದದ್ದು.

title.en: Board: population growth and natural methods

say.en: When death rates, maternal mortality and infant mortality fall but birth rates stay high, the population grows exponentially. At 2 percent a year it doubles in about 35 years.
Natural methods avoid meeting of sperm and ovum. In periodic abstinence a couple avoids coitus from day 10 to 17, when ovulation is expected.
In withdrawal the male withdraws before ejaculation. During intense breastfeeding ovulation usually stops: lactational amenorrhea works up to six months after birth.
Barrier methods stop sperm physically: condoms for men and women, and diaphragms, cervical caps and vaults that cover the cervix. Condoms also protect against STIs.
Board: population growth and natural methods.

narration.en: Natural methods avoid the meeting of ovum and sperm by timing or behaviour; barrier methods block sperm physically. Sort them.

text.en: Periodic abstinence from day 10 to day 17 of the cycle

explanation.en: Natural: periodic abstinence (days 10–17), withdrawal and lactational amenorrhea (up to six months after delivery). Barrier: male and female condoms, diaphragms, cervical caps and vaults, often used with spermicidal creams.
explanation.kn: ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ: ನಿಯತಕಾಲಿಕ ಸಂಯಮ, ಹಿಂತೆಗೆತ, ಹಾಲೂಡಿಕೆ ಅಮೆನೋರಿಯಾ. ತಡೆ: ಕಾಂಡೋಮ್, ಡಯಾಫ್ರಮ್, ಸರ್ವೈಕಲ್ ಕ್ಯಾಪ್.

say.en: Natural methods avoid the meeting of ovum and sperm by timing or behaviour; barrier methods block sperm physically. Sort them.

body.en: *Natural* methods avoid meeting of ovum and sperm. Periodic abstinence avoids coitus from day 10 to 17 of the cycle, when ovulation is expected. In coitus interruptus (withdrawal) the male withdraws before ejaculation. Lactational amenorrhea: ovulation and menstruation usually do not occur during intense breastfeeding, and this works for up to six months after birth. Barrier methods physically stop sperm: condoms for males and females (Nirodh is a popular brand), and diaphragms, cervical caps and vaults that cover the cervix; they are reusable and often used with spermicidal creams. Condoms also protect against STIs and AIDS.
body.kn: ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ವಿಧಾನಗಳು: ನಿಯತಕಾಲಿಕ ಸಂಯಮ (10–17ನೇ ದಿನ), ಹಿಂತೆಗೆತ, ಸ್ತನ್ಯಪಾನ ಅಮೆನೋರಿಯಾ (ಆರು ತಿಂಗಳವರೆಗೆ). ತಡೆ ವಿಧಾನಗಳು: ಕಾಂಡೋಮ್, ಡಯಾಫ್ರಮ್, ಗರ್ಭಕಂಠದ ಟೊಪ್ಪಿಗಳು. ಕಾಂಡೋಮ್ STI ಮತ್ತು ಏಡ್ಸ್‌ನಿಂದಲೂ ರಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A woman with a regular 28-day cycle wants to use periodic abstinence. Which days should she avoid, and why is this method not fully reliable?

steps.en: Ovulation is expected around day 14, and the fertile period is taken as days 10 to 17.
So coitus is avoided from day 10 to day 17 of the cycle.
Cycles often vary in length, so the fertile days may shift, making the method unreliable.

answer.en: Avoid days 10–17; failure rate is high because ovulation timing varies
